mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, sku_code AS skuCode, color, size, price, stock, image FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, product_id AS productId, sku_code AS skuCode, color, size, price, stock, image FROM product_sku WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
